description: Braided tan hemp, chewed to a splay at one end by a Nightmule with opinions. Still holds a knot, mostly.
lore: [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] buys rope. Any rope, any length, over the odds, and a chewed end does not put him off — he ties the chewed end, so the good end takes the weight. A cracker who was certain he was being made a fool of followed him east one autumn to find out what a man wants with forty lengths of hemp. He found him at a gorge crossing, hanging a new line twenty feet along from an old line that ended in air. The far anchor had gone with the ground it was in. Gunnar measured the gap, wrote it in the ledger, finished the knot, and said nothing about any of it at any fire that season. Eight gold is what the rope is worth. The arithmetic is what he is paying for.
gm_notes: Gunnar's silence made physical: he re-hangs the crossings himself rather than post what the eastern line is doing. A player who sells him rope is funding that silence.
